_doc: The Cannery's ten secrets (docs/design/HUB.md §5). 'hint' is what Ludlow says about the nearest unfound one (one hint per visit); 'where' is the space (corkboard map silhouettes); 'reward' is the player-facing reward text; 'clout' is paid once; 'cosmetics' are unlocked (unlocks.cosmetics).

items.name: The Loose Panel
items.hint: Bag three swings funny when you hit it charged... and the wall behind it creaks back...
items.reward: 50 Clout, a new pal, and a way into the crawlspace

items.name: Granny's Old Tooth
items.hint: Granny lost a tooth in '73. Never found it. Never looked behind the walls, either...
items.reward: Cosmetic: Gold Tooth (detachable-piece swap, any fighter)

items.name: The Sleeping Scrapling
items.hint: Something snores under the stairs. A big score on the heavy bag might wake it... catch it before the door...
items.reward: Cosmetic: trash-can lid shield (+25 Clout if caught before the roller door)

items.name: The Belt Case
items.hint: That belt case in the locker room... the Kid stares at it all day. Show it some swagger. Three times...
items.reward: Cosmetic: replica belt (walkout back-piece). The real one is at the cleaners.

items.name: The 1973 Tape
items.hint: Bellows keeps something under his chair. You'd have to get down low to see it. Real low. Guard-up low...
items.reward: The Commissioner's 1973 title fight replay and the Vintage Bellows line pack

items.name: The Freight Elevator
items.hint: The elevator needs a fuse from the boiler's side, a cable spool behind the forklift, and a button the Commission keeps filed away...

items.name: GL_NDCO
items.hint: The sign on the roof is missing its A. Saw it lying by the water tower. Somebody with an arm could put it back...
items.reward: Full neon for the Rooftop's night variant, the Sign Fixer frame and 100 Clout

items.name: The Pier
items.hint: Those gulls sit on something at the water's edge. Splash 'em good... a crate thrown real far ought to do it...
items.reward: A fishing spot: one OTC supplement cosmetic variant per cast, and once, the Chum Rush arena variant 'Pier Night'

items.name: The Face in the Boiler
items.hint: That boiler's got a face if you squint. Warm it up. Hotter. Ten good hot ones ought to do it...
items.reward: Sizzle: an alternate JUICE colour for Stoke

items.name: Something in the Ice Bath
items.hint: Doc's ice bath... nobody ever sits in it long enough to touch the bottom. Thirty seconds, they say...
items.reward: A frozen Blister that follows you around the hub, and 50 Clout
